subtitle: id Software, 1996 · 44,570 lines of C, built id386=0 — the portable path
_target: The TARGET, not a unit list: targets/quake.json describes four platform layers over one engine, and naming it here makes all four appear in the picker beside the program. The descriptor's job is the GAME -- what it is, what it needs, what its keys do.
